briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI race intensifies as frontier models near AGI thresholds

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has accelerated into a multi-polar contest with US and Chinese labs releasing models at unprecedented cadence. Compute constraints and safety concerns are shaping deployment strategies across the board.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4-preview with advanced agentic capabilities while xAI launched Grok-4. DeepSeek-R2 achieved parity on key benchmarks at lower cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines emphasize runtime monitoring for multi-agent interactions.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announced new 100k H100-equivalent clusters. TSMC reports record AI chip demand with 3nm yields improving.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory fragmentation slow US labs more than Chinese competitors by Q4 2026?
